_about: Unit mapping of manifest v4 (content_sha256 3a7417d60e4eb5d0e54433c76139df7ed1221ae35bcccf814b7fca2cf913f113) for the suite results document: every scenario -> chapter, family, unit, unit_type (series | replicates | refusals | pairs | list), variant and optional group; _units carries each unit's title, type and property line; _families each family's chapter and title. Built by units_v4_build.py from the scenario titles; v5 carries the same fields in each scenario's doc block.

R-pos-column-A.property: A window cut from the record resolves fully under the record's taxid column: every k-mer supported, one run [0, L-k+1), graph_runs the same.

R-pos-column-B.property: The same property on a second record per length.

R-pos-header-A.property: A window cut from the record resolves fully under the record's header label (accession.version): every k-mer supported, one run [0, L-k+1), graph_runs the same.

R-pos-header-B.property: The same property on a second record per length.

R-multi.unit_title: taxid, header and an unrelated taxon in one request
R-multi.property: Three labels at once: the record's taxid and header support every k-mer; the unrelated kingdom's column does not support all of them (label_not_full).

R-junction.property: Two records' 100 bp windows concatenated: each column's run ends or starts where the records dictate (A's run reaches past 70 only as far as B's bases repeat A's continuation, and vice versa).

R-discover.property: Discovery (no labels) lists the source record's label, column or header, within max_labels, or states a truncation that can hide it only in a tie at full support.

R-trace.property: support: trace on 200 bp of the record under its own header answers one contiguous run over every k-mer.

R-budget.unit_title: the stated stop and its twins
R-budget.property: A 10 kb resolve under a small time budget stops with a stated prefix the record's label fully supports (or answers 503 deadline); the full 20 s resolve and the continuation from base 5000 agree with it on the prefix (relations prefix_equals).

R-edge-refused.property: Malformed or out-of-bound /resolve requests are refused with HTTP 400 and the exact text (or prefix) the host documents, before any work.

R-edge-accepted.property: Edge inputs the host accepts answer correctly: exactly k bases; an N or IUPAC code (its k-mers absent from the graph); lower case; 1,001 labels; a random sequence (absent); a budget above the cap lowered and stated; and the split cases the service refuses but the host answers.

R-rc.property: The reverse complement of a window unique on both strands: the record's header supports none of its k-mers on this basic (non-canonical) graph.

R-order.property: The same labels in another order are each answered as if alone.

R-twin-case.property: The lower-case resolve (R-edge-0007) answers byte for byte as its upper-case twin (relation same_answer).

T-walk.unit_title: label-constrained walks by direction and extension
T-walk.property: A walk from a seed of the record, constrained to the record's label, spells a substring of the record at the expected position, or stops at a stated branch whose arms both carry the label.

T-derived.property: A seed without explicit labels (permit per_hit) walks under the carrier set the host derives; a path follows the record.

T-end.property: A 31 bp seed near a record end: the walk stops at the record's end with the stated end reason.

T-repeat.property: A seed inside a multi-copy repeat: a branch is stated where the record's copies diverge, and a path of each copy is in the record.

T-labels.property: annotate mode lists every structural successor and a path follows the record; derived column / header labels hold the record's own label; max_labels_per_node 1 is echoed, the cut stated, the walk unchanged.

T-exhaustive.property: The exhaustive trie of radius 100: a leaf follows the record.

T-coords.property: trace with output coordinates: the reported positions equal the record's.

T-budget.property: Each bound (time, memory, work, steps) stops the walk with its own stated reason; the walk so far is in the record.

T-attempts.property: An expired not_after_ms is 409 before any work; an attempt_id states its usage and bound (409 duplicate when retained).

T-edge.property: Malformed seeds, unknown keys and out-of-range knobs are refused with the host's text; duplicate seeds are walked and marked; a budget above the cap is lowered and stated.

T-seeds.property: Three distinct seeds of three records in one request: each walk follows its own record.

T-graphlet.property: output.detail graphlet: the MGT body's walks follow the record.

T-caps.property: bounds.max_output_bp 50 per arm: the arm truncated by it says so; its walk is in the record.

T-quorum.property: min_live_labels 2 on a seed of one header label: every path ends below_min_labels at once (SPEC 6.4).

T-strand.property: The reverse complement of a unique window is not in this basic graph: the seed is refused.

P-exact.unit_title: exact windows by length and mode
P-exact.property: An exact window of the record is found: count mode counts at least the record's context; all_or_count lists the record's contexts at their offsets.

P-placed.property: With labels (predicate_only or all) the record is placed at the window (nt_coords) and its taxid is among the labels.

P-scope-suffix.property: suffix scope finds the record's context at offset k-L.

P-scope-start.unit_title: a record's first bases, any_offset vs suffix
P-scope-start.property: The first 20 bases of a record are found in any_offset scope; the suffix scope's contexts are among them (relation subset).

P-scope-strands.property: strands forward lists only + contexts; strands reverse with the reverse complement lists the record as a - context.

P-scope-palindrome.property: A 16 bp palindrome is searched once and reported with strand '='.

P-iupac-codes.unit_title: IUPAC codes holding the record's bases
P-iupac-codes.property: A 25-mer with 2-4 IUPAC codes holding the record's bases finds the record's contexts.

P-iupac-nrun.property: A run of N, leading or internal, is skipped; the record is still found.

P-modes.property: count gives no list; partial cuts at max_contexts; all_or_count withholds above the threshold; a cap above the limit is lowered and stated; stop_at_threshold; max_contexts 0 returns nothing and says cut (relation subset: the cut list within the complete one).

P-negative.property: A random 31-mer or a shuffled 40-mer is absent: exact 0, complete.

P-floor.property: Patterns below the information floor are refused as such; suffix scope is exempt and a 24-bit IUPAC pattern at the floor is answered.

P-caps.property: max_anchors 0, max_steps 1 / 50 and a 300 ms budget over 16 patterns stop or cut exactly where stated.

P-edge.property: Malformed pattern lists are refused with the host's text; lower case, duplicate ids and in_ram are accepted as documented.

P-more.unit_title: edge positions and a cap above the count
P-more.property: IUPAC codes at the first and last position still find the record; partial with a cap above the count returns the complete list without a cut.

P-heavy.property: A 12- or 16-mer in any_offset scope (heavy): the count is at least the record's contexts.

P-twin.unit_title: twins of edge and IUPAC tests
P-twin.property: The upper-case twin answers as the lower-case test (same_answer); the exact window's contexts are among its IUPAC pattern's (subset).

L-paths.property: long_search paths on a 32-200 bp window of the record: a path spells it.

L-verified.property: paths with labels and require_support record_verified: the record's path is verified.

L-supported.property: Supported paths selected by the taxid predicate, and at the label_intersection level: the record verified.

L-anchors.property: A 45 bp pattern without long_search: anchors counted, paths withheld.

L-caps.property: max_paths 0 cuts (partial) or withholds (all_or_count); max_annotation_work 10 stops or cuts the search.

L-memory.property: A 100 kb homopolymer on a self-loop with max_memory_mb 1 stops on {extension, max_memory}.

L-long-length.property: A 500-2000 bp window with paths: exactly one path spells it.

L-long-other.unit_title: strands, IUPAC and a homopolymer with paths
L-long-other.property: A reverse-complement window under strands reverse is the record's path as '-'; a 60 bp IUPAC pattern's paths hold the record's; A^60 with max_anchors 1 lists its two anchors and admits no extension.

L-repeat.property: A homopolymer of 60 / 100 with paths carries the low_complexity_pattern note.

X-peptide10.property: A decapeptide of a protein searched under its genetic code finds the coding DNA's contexts.

X-peptide-long.property: A 20- or 30-residue peptide with supported paths: a path of its taxid, record verified.

X-table1.property: A decapeptide of another code read in table 1: the record's codons are out of reach (an expected miss).

X-stop-found.property: A protein's last 9 residues and its stop: found at the stop codon under the protein's table.

X-stop-none.property: A stop in a table without stop codons (27, 28, 31): exact 0 without a search.

X-junction.property: A window across an exon junction: no path spells the spliced DNA.

X-edge-ambiguity.property: The ambiguity codes B, Z, J and X stand for their residues: the peptide is still found.

X-edge-other.property: An unknown genetic code is refused; 11 residues without long_search answer anchors only; U is a bad_alphabet slot beside an answered pattern.

M-planted.unit_title: planted substitutions by m and max_mismatches
M-planted.property: A window with m planted substitutions at max_mismatches >= m: the source at level m with the substitutions reported (mirrored in the reverse orientation).

M-below.property: More substitutions than max_mismatches: the source at no level.

M-iupac.property: IUPAC codes plus one substitution: level 1, never at an N; a base inside a set is no substitution.

M-protein-level1.property: A decapeptide with one substituted residue at max_mismatches 1: the source at level 1.

M-protein-cap.property: max_mismatches 2 above the protein cap of 1 is refused.

M-suffix.property: An 18-mer with one substitution in suffix scope: the source at offset k-L, level 1.

M-order.unit_title: level order under a cut or stop
M-order.property: partial releases the lowest levels first; a max_steps stop inside a level leaves the lower levels exact.

M-floor.property: A short pattern at a mismatch count is below the floor by the stated bits, or within it.

M-refusal.property: Out-of-range or wrongly typed max_mismatches and its later_increment combinations are refused with the host's text; a long pattern gets its slot with cap 0; max_mismatches 0 answers as without the field.

M-twin.property: The m = 0 window answers as without max_mismatches (same_answer); its level 0 at max_mismatches 1 holds the exact contexts (subset).

Q-pred-forms.property: any / none / all / at_least n / and-not select the record's contexts as the predicate says.

Q-pred-either.property: any / none / not / all under predicate_strands either select as the predicate says.

Q-pred-unknown.property: An unknown label is listed; any() folds to false (nothing read), none() to true (every context selected).

Q-pred-refusals.property: A number as a name and predicate_only without a predicate are refused with the fix.

Q-strands.property: either on a 16S 20-mer held on both strands: the + contexts by their own row, the mirrors by theirs.

Q-more.unit_title: context strands, or(), and a bad at_least
Q-more.property: The '-' source contexts are selected by their own rows; or() selects; at_least n outside 1..len is refused.

Q-supported.property: Supported paths under none(A) exclude the record's path; under any(A) with either strands the record is verified.

Q-motif.property: predicate_scope motif: selected / false / no_instance per every_context; without a predicate it is refused, predicate_strands alone is a no-op.

Q-budget.property: max_predicate_contexts 1 is not admitted (all_or_count) or cut (partial); max_predicate_work 1 stops the selection as stated.

C-caps.property: The three capabilities documents state identity, limits and the gate block, and name the same server (relations same_answer).

C-protocol.property: gzip / deflate negotiation, uncompressed error bodies, strict JSON, a wrong content type still read, GET on a POST route not served.

N-negative-random.property: Random DNA of 31-200 bp on /pattern: exact 0, complete.

N-negative-shuffled.property: A shuffled record window: 0 paths on /pattern and no k-mer in the graph on /resolve.

N-negative-discover.property: Random DNA under discovery: nothing to discover.

N-negative-seed.property: A random seed on /traverse: the seed's 400, never a walk.

N-negative-peptide.property: A random peptide of 10-30 low-degeneracy residues: exact 0.

N-nearmiss-pairs.unit_title: out of reach, and the pair that is back
N-nearmiss-pairs.property: More substitutions than max_mismatches put the source out of reach; the pair with m substitutions brings it back at level m.

N-nearmiss-peptide.property: A decapeptide with 2-4 substituted residues at max_mismatches 1: out of reach.

N-nearmiss-mutated.property: A substitution every 15 bases leaves no k-mer of the record; one substitution breaks the runs there with both sides supported; a mutated seed is refused by /traverse.

N-nearmiss2.property: A 25-mer with 3 spread substitutions and a reverse-complement 31-mer with 4 are out of reach; the pair with 1 substitution is back at level 1.

N-hard-lowcomplex.property: Low-complexity patterns: exact counts within the stated bound, the note stated or absent as documented; with paths, stated stops or a cut.

N-hard-repeat.property: A 31-mer of a multi-copy repeat is counted and resolved with every k-mer carried; a telomeric seed re-enters itself at 0 bp (rejoined_seed).

N-realrep.property: Real tandem repeats of the records: the pattern's contexts (note as documented), the resolve fully supported, the traverse following the record to its re-entry.

N-usecase-primers.property: A universal 16S primer (IUPAC) on both strands is counted, at least E. coli K-12's sites.

N-usecase-strand.property: A forward-only search of a reverse primer or of a reverse complement counts what the record holds on +.

N-usecase-floor.property: Too short or too degenerate patterns are below the floor; a 26-bit degenerate one is admitted and costly.

N-usecase-identify.property: Identify a read: discovery names its taxid; its first 31 bp are placed in its record.

N-usecase-defect.property: The 2026-10-09 defect: a 31-mer of NC_000932.1 is in the graph but its header carries none of it.

N-zero.property: exact 0 on /pattern iff a k-mer is absent on /resolve (relation zero_equals_absent).

D-P.unit_title: repeats of /pattern up to k scenarios
D-P.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

D-R.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

D-L.unit_title: repeats of /pattern longer than k scenarios
D-L.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

D-M.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

D-T.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.

D-Q.property: Three repeats of a source scenario answer the same digest on every arm (deterministic), the source's own checks passing each time.
